:::{#exm-de-morgan}
#### De Morgan's laws for die rolls

In $S = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$,
let $A = \set{2, 4, 6}$ and $B = \set{1, 2, 3}$, as in @exm-set-operations,
so $A^c = \set{1, 3, 5}$ and $B^c = \set{4, 5, 6}$.

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  (A \cup B)^c &= \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 6}^c \\
  &= \set{5},
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  and

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  A^c \cap B^c &= \set{1, 3, 5} \cap \set{4, 5, 6} \\
  &= \set{5}.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  (A \cap B)^c &= \set{2}^c \\
  &= \set{1, 3, 4, 5, 6},
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  and

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  A^c \cup B^c &= \set{1, 3, 5} \cup \set{4, 5, 6} \\
  &= \set{1, 3, 4, 5, 6}.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

:::
